name: app-curved-activity-picker-wheel-icons
title: Curved Activity Picker Wheel
whatItIs: A light phone screen with a vertical arc of activity options (Sleep, Skipping, Power Training, Cycling, Swimming, Tennis, Basketball), each with a pastel icon tile, the selected Cycling highlighted in a pink pill and the rest fading out at top and bottom.
whatItMeans: Bending the list along an arc mimics a physical dial, making selection tactile and playful, with fading edges focusing on the centre.
techniques: List bent along a circular path like a wheel
Selected item enlarged and outlined in accent colour
Items fade and shrink with distance from the centre
Each option gets its own tiny pastel icon colour
Grab handle on the arc's edge as an affordance

vocabulary.definition: A selector where options rotate past a fixed focus point.
Reducing size and opacity of items away from focus.
A visual cue that shows how something can be used.
